lastChange.note: No change a person sees. The generated files now end as the kstrl repository's commit hooks leave them (no trailing whitespace, one newline at the end), so committing them does not alter them; the pixel checks confirm every frame renders as before. Two names that the spell check read as typos are renamed: a class in Settings (sav to saves) and a variable in Chrome's script (fitH to fitHd); the deliberate [verfy] in Settings is marked as deliberate.
